name: Dioxins and PCBs
aliases: dioxins, polychlorinated biphenyls, PCBs, furans, dioxinas, bifenilos policlorados
what_is: Highly toxic persistent organic pollutants that bioaccumulate in fatty tissues.
why_botia: Dioxins and dioxin-like PCBs persist and build up in fatty foods and the body, in both sexes. Pregnancy and breastfeeding matter because a mother's body burden can expose the fetus or infant — not because bioaccumulation is uniquely female.
can_1: Identify high-risk fat-containing ingredients that are primary dietary sources.
can_2: Provide safety details on maternal body burdens and transgenerational transfer.
cannot_1: Determine the Toxic Equivalency without laboratory analysis.
cannot_2: Confirm if the product exceeds the European Tolerable Weekly Intake.
